verdict.rationale: Better Stack's AI SRE page directly claims an automated post-mortem generated from the incident timeline and Slack, which covers the core of the story. The claim is a single marketing line, and no documentation describes what the draft contains or how it is reviewed. missing for 10: documented post-mortem structure (timeline, contributing factors, follow-up action items), an explicit human review/edit workflow for the draft, in-depth docs, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, AI drafts the postmortem from the incident record — timeline, contributing factors, follow-ups — ready for human review

citations.quote: Get an automated post-mortem based on the incident timeline and Slack.
